episodes.synopsis: At a party, reserved college student Kakeru meets a mysterious and charming young woman who is unable to see.
episodes.title: An Encounter

episodes.synopsis: Kakeru takes Koyuki to try out an old piano and the two tour a Meiji era sailboat that is preserved on campus.
episodes.title: Fuyutsuki Koharu

episodes.synopsis: Kakeru and Koharu go to karaoke with friends and decide to check out the university's fireworks club together.
episodes.title: The Yellow Bookmark

episodes.synopsis: Kakeru and Koharu go on their fireworks shopping trip and then enjoy a very relaxing ride home on a water bus.
episodes.title: First Date

episodes.synopsis: Kakeru and his roommate Narumi get a chance to take Koharu and Yuko for a ride on the college's cutter boat.
episodes.title: Aerial Fireworks

episodes.synopsis: Kakeru shares an intimate moment with Koharu and then turns to Narumi and Hayase for advice on how to proceed.
episodes.title: The Empty Terrace Seat

episodes.synopsis: After Koharu disappears for a week, Kakeru and Yuko get a clue about where she is and run out to look for her.
episodes.title: Transparent

episodes.synopsis: Hoping to spend time with Koharu, Kakeru and friends decide to volunteer at the hospital where she is staying.
episodes.title: Pangs of Love

episodes.synopsis: Still volunteering at the hospital, Kakeru learns more about Koharu's illness and happens to meet her mother.
episodes.title: Alone

episodes.synopsis: Kakeru stays with Koharu through her ups and downs while Yuko takes the lead on preparing the fireworks show.
episodes.title: Stay By Her Side

episodes.synopsis: With the fireworks event approaching, Koharu keeps working step by step toward regaining some of her strength.
episodes.title: Sorano Kakeru
